description: Timeline Events is a Power BI visual designed to bring clarity and context to your data by overlaying key events directly on the trendline. It helps you uncover the why behind performance changes, spikes, drops, and anomalies—making it easier to explain trends with clear cause-and-effect relationships. Whether you're analyzing sales, operations, marketing, or financial performance, Timeline Events lets you map impactful moments—like campaign launches, regulation changes, system outages, product releases, or market shifts—onto time-series data to visualize their direct influence. You're in full control of the look and feel: customize event markers, labels, tooltips, and layout to match your narrative. Use rich formatting options to highlight critical milestones or categorize events by type or importance. Perfect for executive dashboards or any report where storytelling matters, Timeline Events transforms data exploration into insight by turning trends into stories you can see and explain.
